annotation.title_clean: 无锡市低空经济发展促进条例
annotation.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Regulations on Promoting the Development of the Low-Altitude Economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 无锡市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Wuxi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee); approved by Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee
annotation.summary_en: Wuxi municipal regulation, effective 1 October 2025, promoting the low-altitude economy (drones and other low-altitude aircraft). It covers infrastructure, flight services, application scenarios, industry development, incentives and safety assurance, including liability insurance, a safety guarantee fund, incident reporting and data/privacy restrictions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government builds low-altitude infrastructure and a municipal intelligent connected flight service platform.
Operators bear primary responsibility for flight safety and must report abnormal flight incidents.
Non-micro/light non-commercial aircraft operators must buy liability insurance; a low-altitude safety guarantee fund may advance compensation.
Aircraft must not be used to unlawfully collect personal data or conduct illegal photography or surveying.
Supports drone logistics, medical delivery, emergency rescue, and industry incentives, finance and talent policies.
